input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision granting audit/inspection rights against us (no comparable inspection or verification right appears elsewhere). It matches the preferred position on every parameter: frequency limited to once in any twelve-month period; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours with no unreasonable disruption; off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears cost unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly or unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or third-party confidential information (22.2). Section 22.3 additionally protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information, limiting use to enforcement, requiring delivery of the final report, and making payment of a shortfall dispositive absent fraud or demonstrable error. No redline needed.
